title: Rabbi Chanina son of Rav Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Petichta of Esther Rabbah, 8. In Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2: Rabbi Chanina son of Rabbi Ada in the name of Rabbi Tanchum bar Acha: “…and more stringent than the words of the Torah.” The statement is cited in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:4, and there: Rabbi Chananyah son of Rav Ada in the name of Rabbi Tanchum son of Rabbi Chiyya.

notes.text: The comparison makes the additional teaching more stringent than Torah, rather than making Torah more stringent. The named Jerusalem Talmud comparison and its elders/prophets wording are kept distinct from Hyman’s formulation.
